rationale: C08 is the strongest plausible drafting template because it is the immediately preceding displayed emergency-board order issued by the same administration and reproduces nearly the entire recital-and-operative structure verbatim, with only the disputing carrier, employee representative, and one geographic phrase changed. C01 is an exceptionally close textual match, while C13 is especially relevant because it applies the same machinery to the same Southern Pacific entity. The extensive shared language and identical sequence go well beyond merely implementing the same statutory duty.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Southern Pacific Company (Pacific Lines), a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Order of Railroad Telegraphers, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pan American World Airways, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Flight Engineers' International Association, PAA Chapter, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital uses the same sentence-level drafting frame, substituting only the carrier and labor organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The first operative provision is verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Southern Pacifie Company (Pacific Lines), or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pan American World Airways, Inc., or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The statutory standstill mechanism and its wording are identical apart from substitution of the regulated carrier.
